Wayleaper's Heavy Aspect Armour.brief: INFANTRY only: M 14", Sv 3+, [Deep Strike], gains FLY and JUMP PACK; can only be attached to Swooping Hawks or Warp Spiders.

Weapon Forge.brief: Start of Declare Battle Formations: one DRUKHARI Crusade unit (not EPIC HERO, no Weapon Modification yet): one weapon of one model gains the Weapon Modification Battle Honour for the battle.

Weapon Sentinels.brief: Ranged attack targeting a unit within 12": you can ignore any or all modifiers to BS, the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

Weapon Support System#42cb4fb6b8.brief: Bearer's ranged attacks: ignore any or all Hit roll modifiers.

Weapon Support System#6cc270c310.brief: Ranged attacks by the unit: can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Weaponised Hatred.brief: Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if bearer is on the battlefield: 1 enemy unit visible to bearer becomes your Vendetta target.

Weapons of the First Legion.brief: Bearer's melee weapons: +1 A, +1 S, +1 D; while the bearer is Battle-shocked: +2 A, +2 S, +2 D instead.

Weavefield crest#69afb138bd.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ Inv.

Weaver of Sagas.brief: WOLF PRIEST only. Once per round, your Movement phase, start or end of this unit's move: 1 friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6", or 1 friendly GREY HUNTERS unit within 18", is no longer Battle-shocked.

Weavers' Wail.brief: TROUPE MASTER: bearer's melee weapons +3 S and +1 A.

Webway Awl.brief: ARCHON: bearer's unit has [Deep Strike]; Rapid Ingress on it for 0CP.

Webway Pathstone.brief: ANHRATHE only: models have Deep Strike; once per battle, end of opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range: remove the unit and place it in Strategic Reserves.

Webway Spar.brief: Once per turn, end of your Movement phase, one Crusade unit (once per battle each): roll one D6: 1 = D3 MW; 2+ = remove and set up anywhere more than 9" from enemy units.

Webway walker.brief: HARLEQUINS or DRUKHARI: bearer's unit has [Deep Strike]; set up by Deep Strike while losing the wager: re-roll Charge rolls for it until end of turn.

Whirling Death.brief: Leading a unit, when it Advances: no Advance roll, +6" M until end of phase; ignore vertical distance on Advance moves.

Whirling Onslaught.brief: Melee attacks: re-roll Hit rolls of 1; if this unit charged this turn: re-roll Hit rolls.

Whispering Web.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model shot: pick one enemy unit hit; until end of turn, friendly AELDARI attacks vs it score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

Whispers of the Shadow Forest (psychic l.brief: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if not battle-shocked: psychic roll D6, 1 = this unit battle-shocked; attacks targeting this unit -1 to Hit until end of phase.

Will of Auramite.brief: Can be targeted by stratagems even while battle-shocked.

Will of Iron.brief: First time destroyed: remove it, then at end of phase roll D6; on 2+, set back up as close as possible, not in Engagement Range, with 3 W.

Will of the Faithful.brief: After each Crusade battle: ignore your first failed Out of Action test.

Will of the Hive Mind.brief: Once per battle round, when a friendly TYRANIDS unit within 12" is targeted by a Stratagem: that use costs 1CP less.

Willbreaker.brief: Fight phase, after bearer's attacks: 1 enemy unit hit takes a Battle-shock test.

Wimp-Kickaz Upgrade.brief: NOBZ unit only. Enemy unit engaged with this unit falling back: must use desperate escape; if this unit is riled up, -1 to those hazard rolls.

Wind Walker.brief: Ranged attacks have [Assault]; when selected to advance, this unit can change advance rolls to a 6.

Winged Biomorph.brief: NODE or PRIME ORGANISM only: M becomes 12", gains FLY and VANGUARD INVADER keywords and Deep Strike; if INFANTRY: can only be attached to GARGOYLES.

Winged Strike (Pain).brief: Your Shooting phase, when selected: spend 1 Pain token to Empower; while Empowered, ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls.

Winged Swarm.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting, if not within Engagement Range: Normal move up to 6"; then cannot declare a charge this turn.

Wise Orator.brief: Once per battle, start of the battle round: until end of turn, aura: friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model get +1 to Wound roll on melee attacks.

Witch Hunter.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's attacks on a PSYKER unit re-roll Hit rolls.

Witherbone Pipes.brief: While leading a POXWALKERS unit: +1 OC for that unit's models, and +1 to its Battle-shock and Leadership tests.

Withering Hail.brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: select one enemy unit hit by the exterminator autocannon; until end of phase, friendly ASTRA MILITARUM attacks on it have AP improved by 1 (once per phase per unit).

Wolf Lord's Chosen.brief: INFANTRY only: M 7"; can also be attached to BLOOD CLAWS, GREY HUNTERS, WOLF GUARD HEADTAKERS.

Wolf Master.brief: Your Command phase: select 1 friendly SPACE WOLVES unit within 9"; until your next Command phase, its teeth and claws and Tyrnak and Fenrir weapons have [Lethal Hits].

Wolf-tail Talisman.brief: Each attack allocated to the bearer: -1 D.

Wolf-Touched.brief: This unit has the WULFEN keyword and +2" M.

Wolves' Wisdom.brief: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY only. With The Great Wolf Watches Detachment rule, bearer's unit can charge units within 6" instead of 3".

Word of the Emperor.brief: DIALOGUS only. Each time your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem: that use costs 1 CP more.

Word of the Phoenix (Psychic).brief: Leading a unit, your Command phase: D6, on 2+ D3+1 destroyed BODYGUARD models (not SUPPORT WEAPON) return with full W.

Words of the Righteous.brief: Blooded rank or higher; start of the Fight phase: each enemy unit within 3" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, at -1 if CHAOS.

Worthy Foes.brief: Your Command phase: select 1 enemy unit; until your next Command phase, NOBLE, LYCHGUARD and TRIARCH attacks against it: +1 to Wound.

Worthy Offerings.brief: Crusade: after each battle, 1 of these Requisitions once at -1 RP: Sacrifice to the Dark Gods, Mortal Empowerment.

Wracking Agonies (Psychic).brief: Your Shooting phase, after shooting: 1 INFANTRY unit hit by Agonising Energies, until start of your next turn: -2" M and -2 to charge rolls.

Wraith Form.brief: Each time this unit ends a Normal move: 1 enemy unit moved over, D6 per model in this unit: each 4+ = 1 MW.

Wrath of the Emperor.brief: Crusade: complete 2 battles in which you destroyed 4+ units by the start of battle round 3.

Wrath of the Machine Spirit.brief: Ranged attacks targeting a unit within 12": [Devastating Wounds] vs non-MONSTER/VEHICLE.

Wrath of the Omnissiah.brief: Your Shooting phase, after this model has shot: 1 enemy unit hit must take a Battle-shock test.

Wrath of the Wronged.brief: While 1+ PSYKER in the unit: attacks +1 to Hit if below Starting Strength, and +1 to Wound as well if Below Half-strength.

Wreathed in Shadows (Aura, Psychic).brief: Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA or SHADOW LEGION unit within 6": can only be targeted by ranged attacks from models within 18".

Writ of Acquisition.brief: Your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit shot: gain 1YP per assailed unit hit (max 3YP).

Wulfen Stone.brief: Bearer's melee weapons +2 A and +2 S; while leading, unit's melee weapons [Sustained Hits 1] ([Sustained Hits 2] if bearer is a WOLF GUARD BATTLE LEADER).

Wurrboy (psyker level 1).brief: This model has the psychic abilities listed below.

Wyrdmaker's Helm.brief: Once per battle round, instead of a Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw for the bearer: that roll is automatically an unmodified 6.

Wyredjinn.brief: Start of your Command phase, if on the battlefield: roll 1 D6, +1 if within range of an objective you control; on 4+ gain 1CP.

Wyrmslayer Divination.brief: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS only. Once, your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot: until end of phase, attacks vs a unit that can FLY re-roll Hit rolls.

Wyrmsplitter.brief: Bearer's attacks vs MONSTER or VEHICLE: +1 to Wound roll and +1 D.

Xenos Hunter.brief: While leading a unit: attacks targeting an enemy unit without IMPERIUM or CHAOS get +1 to Hit.

Xenos Savagery.brief: Once per battle, start of Fight phase: until end of phase, [Fights First].

Xirat’p’s Sorcerous Barrages (Psychic).brief: End of your Movement phase, each enemy unit within 6": roll D6, on 2-3 it suffers 1 MW; on 4-5 D3 MW; on 6 D6 MW.

Xylocil.brief: Crusade. Melee weapons of EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models of your Crusade army: +1 S.

Yvraine's Champion.brief: Leading a unit: other CHARACTER models attached to it have Feel No Pain 4+.

Zaall, the Wrathful.brief: Bearer gains KHORNE. Fight phase, if bearer's unit makes a Dark Pact: until end of phase, bearer's melee weapons +3 S and +1 D.

Zealot#e15ccb9771.brief: Once per battle, Fight phase: until end of phase, melee weapons of this model get +3 S and +3 A.

Zealot#e20c54f353.brief: Once per battle, Fight phase: until end of phase, +3 A and +3 S on this model's melee weapons.

Zealous Devotion.brief: Each time this unit makes a Charge move: until end of turn, WS of its melee weapons improved by 1.

Zealous Fortitude.brief: This unit has [Feel No Pain 4+] against mortal wounds.

Zealous Intervention.brief: Heroic Intervention Stratagem on this unit costs 1 CP less, even if already used on another unit this phase.

Zealous Path.brief: While leading a unit: re-roll Charge rolls for that unit.

Zealous Vanguard#1358b0bb9e.brief: Models in the bearer's unit have [Scouts 6"].
